summary: The change rejects overflowing multiline pastes before mutating rows and adds regression coverage for full origins and redirects groups. No actionable defects found.

evidence: public/admin_projects.js lines 149-152 detect a paste that would exceed 50 rows and set the error status before calling renderRows, so existing saved rows are neither replaced nor truncated.

tests/admin_projects_test.ts lines 125-154 paste an extra value into the first row of a full 50-entry group for both origins and redirects, assert the original values and row nodes are preserved, and verify the subsequent save payload retains every saved entry.
tests/bun_test.ts line 3 imports the new test module so the regression coverage runs in the Bun test suite.
